-- Every declaration also takes the ambient section variables (left out below): the Go semantics
-- (`ext`, `ffi`, `go_gctx`, `sem`, the package's `Assumptions`), `GF`, `hG`, `StorageModel GF`, `AllG GF`.

theorem Membership.applyGo_restorable {o : ConfChangeIM} {m m' : Membership} : m.WellFormed →
    m.Restorable → Membership.applyGo o m = some m' → m'.Restorable

def (sealed) ownTrackerM (trk : tracker.ProgressTracker) (mo : Option Membership) : IProp GF

theorem ownTrackerM_assemble [package_sem : Assumptions] (trk : tracker.ProgressTracker) (cfg :
    tracker.Config) (prs : Loc) (m : Membership) : ownTrackerM trk none ∗ ownCfgPairM cfg prs m ⊢
    ownTrackerM { Config' := cfg, Progress' := prs, Votes' := trk.Votes', MaxInflight' :=
    trk.MaxInflight', MaxInflightBytes' := trk.MaxInflightBytes' } (some m)

theorem Membership.applyChange_restorable {o : ConfChangeIM} {m m' : Membership} : m.WellFormed →
    m.Restorable → Membership.applyChange o m = some m' → m'.Restorable

theorem Membership.applyChange_of_applyGo {o : ConfChangeIM} {m m' : Membership} (h :
    Membership.applyGo o m = some m') : Membership.applyChange o m = if GMap.size m'.ids < 2 ^ 62
    then some m' else none

theorem Membership.applyChange_eq_applyGo (o : ConfChangeIM) (m : Membership) :
    Membership.applyChange o m = Option.filter (fun m' => decide (GMap.size m'.ids < 2 ^ 62))
    (Membership.applyGo o m)

def confchange.Changer.LeaveJoint.apiSpec : Prop :=
  ∀ (p : Loc) (chg : confchange.Changer) (m : Membership) (o : ConfChangeIM) (dq : DFrac),
    ccV2Of o = (W32 0, []) →
      ⊢
        ∀ Φ,
          isPkgInit pkg_id.go_etcd_io.raft.v3.confchange ∗ typedPointsto p chg dq ∗ ownTrackerM chg.Tracker' (some m) -∗
            (▷
                ∀ cfg prs err,
                  typedPointsto p chg dq ∗
                      ownTrackerM chg.Tracker' (some m) ∗
                        ((∃ m', ⌜err = GoInterface.nil ∧ Membership.applyGo o m = some m'⌝ ∗ ownCfgPairM cfg prs m') ∨
                          ⌜err ≠ GoInterface.nil ∧ Membership.applyGo o m = none⌝) -∗
                    Φ ((intoVal cfg, intoVal prs), intoVal err)) -∗
              WP
                ((intoVal
                    (methods confchange.Changer.ty.PointerType
                      go!"LeaveJoint" (intoVal p)))
                  (intoVal ()))
                {{ Φ }}

theorem Membership.applyChange_of_applyGo_none {o : ConfChangeIM} {m : Membership} (h :
    Membership.applyGo o m = none) : Membership.applyChange o m = none

def confchange.Restore.apiSpec : Prop :=
  ∀ (chg : confchange.Changer) (cs : Loc) (c : ConfStateM) (dq : DFrac) (m : Membership),
    confStateIs c m →
      m.WellFormed →
        m.Restorable →
          ⊢
            ∀ Φ,
              isPkgInit pkg_id.go_etcd_io.raft.v3.confchange ∗ ownCSM cs dq c ∗ ownTrackerM chg.Tracker' none -∗
                (▷
                    ∀ cfg prs,
                      ownCSM cs dq c ∗ ownCfgPairM cfg prs m -∗
                        Φ ((intoVal cfg, intoVal prs), intoVal GoInterface.nil)) -∗
                  WP (((intoVal (functions confchange.Restore [])) (intoVal chg)) (intoVal cs)) {{ Φ }}

theorem Membership.applyChange_asV2 (c : ConfChangeM) (m : Membership) : Membership.applyChange
    (ConfChangeIM.v1 c) m = Membership.applyChange (ConfChangeIM.v2 c.asV2) m

theorem confAt_restorable [package_sem : Assumptions] (γ : Cluster) (k : Nat) (m : Membership) :
    confAt γ k m ⊢ ⌜m.Restorable⌝

def confchange.Changer.EnterJoint.apiSpec : Prop :=
  ∀ (p : Loc) (chg : confchange.Changer) (m : Membership) (o : ConfChangeIM) (t : w32) (l : List ConfChangeSingleM)
    (autoLeave : Bool) (ccs : GoSlice) (ls : List Loc) (dq dqs : DFrac),
    ccV2Of o = (t, l) →
      enterJointOf t l.length = some (autoLeave, true) →
        ⊢
          ∀ Φ,
            isPkgInit pkg_id.go_etcd_io.raft.v3.confchange ∗
                typedPointsto p chg dq ∗
                  ownSlice ccs ls dqs ∗ ([∗list] q;c ∈ ls;l, ccsRO q c) ∗ ownTrackerM chg.Tracker' (some m) -∗
              (▷
                  ∀ cfg prs err,
                    typedPointsto p chg dq ∗
                        ownSlice ccs ls dqs ∗
                          ownTrackerM chg.Tracker' (some m) ∗
                            ((∃ m', ⌜err = GoInterface.nil ∧ Membership.applyGo o m = some m'⌝ ∗ ownCfgPairM cfg prs m') ∨
                              ⌜err ≠ GoInterface.nil ∧ Membership.applyGo o m = none⌝) -∗
                      Φ ((intoVal cfg, intoVal prs), intoVal err)) -∗
                WP
                  (((intoVal
                        (methods confchange.Changer.ty.PointerType
                          go!"EnterJoint" (intoVal p)))
                      (intoVal autoLeave))
                    (intoVal ccs))
                  {{ Φ }}

theorem Membership.applyGo_asV2 (c : ConfChangeM) (m : Membership) : Membership.applyGo
    (ConfChangeIM.v1 c) m = Membership.applyGo (ConfChangeIM.v2 c.asV2) m

def confchange.Changer.Simple.apiSpec : Prop :=
  ∀ (p : Loc) (chg : confchange.Changer) (m : Membership) (o : ConfChangeIM) (t : w32) (l : List ConfChangeSingleM)
    (al : Bool) (ccs : GoSlice) (ls : List Loc) (dq dqs : DFrac),
    ccV2Of o = (t, l) →
      ¬(t = W32 0 ∧ l = []) →
        enterJointOf t l.length = some (al, false) →
          ⊢
            ∀ Φ,
              isPkgInit pkg_id.go_etcd_io.raft.v3.confchange ∗
                  typedPointsto p chg dq ∗
                    ownSlice ccs ls dqs ∗ ([∗list] q;c ∈ ls;l, ccsRO q c) ∗ ownTrackerM chg.Tracker' (some m) -∗
                (▷
                    ∀ cfg prs err,
                      typedPointsto p chg dq ∗
                          ownSlice ccs ls dqs ∗
                            ownTrackerM chg.Tracker' (some m) ∗
                              ((∃ m',
                                  ⌜err = GoInterface.nil ∧ Membership.applyGo o m = some m'⌝ ∗ ownCfgPairM cfg prs m') ∨
                                ⌜err ≠ GoInterface.nil ∧ Membership.applyGo o m = none⌝) -∗
                        Φ ((intoVal cfg, intoVal prs), intoVal err)) -∗
                  WP
                    ((intoVal
                        (methods confchange.Changer.ty.PointerType go!"Simple" (intoVal p)))
                      (intoVal ccs))
                    {{ Φ }}

theorem ownCfgPairM_size [package_sem : Assumptions] (cfg : tracker.Config) (prs : Loc) (m :
    Membership) : ownCfgPairM cfg prs m ⊢ ∃ M dq, ownMap prs dq M ∗ ⌜M.size = GMap.size m.ids⌝ ∗
    (ownMap prs dq M -∗ ownCfgPairM cfg prs m)

theorem Membership.Valid.snapListsOk' {m : Membership} {cs : ConfStateM} {t i : w64} {d : List w8} :
    m.Valid → m.Restorable → confStateIs cs m → GMap.size m.ids < 2 ^ 61 → uint.Z i < 2 ^ 61 →
    SnapListsOk { sid := { term' := t, index' := i }, cl := cs.lists, al := m.autoLeave, dat := d }

def tracker.MakeProgressTracker.apiSpec : Prop :=
  ∀ (maxInflight maxBytes : w64),
    0 ≤ sint.Z maxInflight ∧ sint.Z maxInflight < 2 ^ 62 →
      ⊢
        ∀ Φ,
          isPkgInit pkg_id.go_etcd_io.raft.v3.tracker -∗
            (▷ ∀ tv, ownTrackerM tv none -∗ Φ (intoVal tv)) -∗
              WP (((intoVal (functions tracker.MakeProgressTracker [])) (intoVal maxInflight)) (intoVal maxBytes)) {{ Φ }}

theorem Membership.restorable_simple (vs : GSet w64) (h : ¬W64 0 ∈ vs) : (Membership.simple
    vs).Restorable

theorem Membership.restorable_empty : Membership.empty.Restorable

def (sealed) ownCfgPairM (cfg : tracker.Config) (prs : Loc) (m : Membership) : IProp GF

def Membership.Restorable (m : Membership) : Prop :=
  ¬W64 0 ∈ m.ids ∧ ∀ (k : w64), k ∈ m.learnersNext → ¬k ∈ m.voters

def (sealed) Membership.applyGo (o : ConfChangeIM) (m : Membership) : Option Membership
